operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no operation for encoding raw image pixels with a ViT. project applies after numerical features already exist, while lookup and reshape do not represent the documented ViT computation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Neighbor embedding stacking along a new neighbor axis
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no stack operation that creates a new axis from separately encoded neighbor embeddings. concatenate joins inputs along an existing declared axis, while reshape and partition do not establish the documented stack construction.

operation_proposals.source_operation: 1D convolution followed by global average pooling
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no primitive for the stated convolution-plus-GAP computation.

The paper states that the diameter index is embedded but does not document a table lookup or numerical projection implementation. lookup requires an explicit table operand, while project represents a documented learned numerical mapping rather than an unspecified categorical embedding mechanism.

operation_proposals.source_operation: FiLM feature-wise scaling and shifting conditioned on spot diameter
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no conditional feature-wise affine modulation operation. project can represent generation of FiLM parameters, but not the subsequent scale-and-shift application.
align represents correspondence alignment, not the documented positive/negative pair contrastive objective with temperature-scaled similarity and within-modality cosine smoothing.

operation_proposals.source_operation: MSE reconstruction and weighted joint training objective
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no loss or weighted-objective primitive for the documented MSE reconstruction term and its weighted combination with contrastive loss.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Sequential section prediction stacking into a volume
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper documents sequential volume assembly, while concatenate requires multiple explicit operands and reshape does not establish the section-order assembly operation.
